sections.text: 6. Edge Cases
6.1 Empty tags — should render nothing / blank line

Paragraph after empty paragraph.

Normal text after empty b tag.
6.2 Deeply nested inline styles
Four levels deep: outer b, i, u, span, inner b
6.3 Plain text mixed with HTML — no tags
This is plain text with no HTML tags at all. The renderer should treat it as a single plain text run.
6.4 Unsupported tags — stripped, content preserved
These tags are strikethrough — stripped, superscript — stripped, subscript — stripped, but the text content should still appear in the output.
6.5 Special characters and Unicode

Special characters: & < > " — all should render as literals.

Unicode: — (em dash), – (en dash), ’ (smart quote), © (copyright), • (bullet symbol).

Emoji treated as text: ✅ ❌ ⚠
6.6 Long content in a single rich text block

Extended paragraph test. This paragraph contains a large volume of text mixed with inline formatting to verify that line wrapping, paragraph flow and run continuity all work correctly across multiple lines of content in a single paragraph block. The text continues with italic segments and coloured segments and underlined segments appearing at various points throughout the paragraph to exercise the style inheritance mechanism across word boundaries.
